# Banner: a rust cloth with a gold band and a pointed tail hanging from a pole, flat (double sided
# in the bake), origin at the pole's centre. Up Z, faces -Y.
new
material new Cloth --base-color 0.6745 0.4196 0.1490 --no-slot
material new Trim --base-color 0.9647 0.8039 0.1490 --no-slot
material new Pole --base-color 0.2000 0.1098 0.0902 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Pole --size 1 --location 0 0 0
scale 0.9 0.08 0.08
apply --scale
material assign Pole
add mesh cube --name Cloth --size 1 --location 0 0 -0.55
scale 0.62 0.05 1.0
apply --scale
mode edit
select vert where "pos.z < -0.4 && abs(pos.x) < 0.01"
mode object
material assign Cloth
add mesh cone --name Tail --vertices 4 --radius1 0.44 --radius2 0 --depth 0.3 --location 0 0 -1.15 --rotation 0 180 45
apply --rotation
scale 1 0.11 1
apply --scale
material assign Cloth
add mesh cube --name Band --size 1 --location 0 -0.035 -0.35
scale 0.62 0.03 0.14
apply --scale
material assign Trim
select Pole Cloth Tail Band
active Cloth
join
rename Cloth Banner
shade flat
export banner.glb
